request_budget_contract.admission_semantics: The deadline includes semaphore admission. Re-entrant calls in one logical request reuse the lease and cannot deadlock at concurrency one.
request_budget_contract.timeout_semantics: A caller receives a stable ServiceTimeoutError at its deadline. Non-cancellable thread or database work remains shielded and retains the shared permit until actual completion, so repeated timeouts cannot exceed configured backend concurrency.
request_budget_contract.source_response_semantics: PDF verification, page rendering, and response preparation share the request lease. File-body transmission starts a fresh 45-second phase, includes reacquisition wait, and retains the lease through the real ASGI body/background completion. Client cancellation records error after the detached stream actually ends.
request_budget_contract.observability_semantics: Audit and anonymous metric persistence use an independent bounded auxiliary lane so timeout responses do not reacquire or queue behind their own read lease.
request_budget_contract.postgres_timeout_normalization: psycopg QueryCanceled from statement_timeout is normalized to ServiceTimeoutError and the durable outcome is timeout; lock_timeout LockNotAvailable remains error.
verification: repeated timed-out synchronous work never exceeded configured backend concurrency
readiness flood stayed inside the same admission budget
source preparation, body timeout, and cancellation outcome regressions passed
actual PostgreSQL pg_sleep statement timeout and owner-held lock timeout were bounded
